items.title: US military aircraft leave second UK base
items.summary: The departures come weeks after the US withdrew bombers from RAF Fairford airbase over a suspected Iran-linked security incident.

items.title: Met Police investigate several reports on Russell Brand following his conviction
items.summary: Det Supt Andy Furphy says the force had received "several reports in during the trial and since the trial".

items.title: Sales of tinned food and bottled water jump after 'Be Ready' campaign launch
items.summary: Sales of essential goods such as hand sanitiser soar after the government called on households to be prepared for emergencies.

items.title: Watch: Meghan's first public appearance since father arrested
items.summary: Meghan arrived at the European Parliament in Brussels with her husband, Prince Harry, who delivered a speech about online child safety.

items.title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England
items.summary: The government says it is strengthening its guidance for schools in England, which came into force in June.

items.title: Kim Kardashian's Skims offers refunds for $148 advent calendar after backlash
items.summary: The contents of the calendar, including hair clips and keychains, have been widely criticised on social media.

items.title: Israel's new parliament to be sworn in as leaders compete to form government
items.summary: Benjamin Netanyahu's main political rival, Gadi Eisenkot, has first chance to build a new government and oust the prime minister.

items.title: Edinburgh Academy pupils suffered decades of 'dreadful abuse'
items.summary: A report from the Scottish Child Abuse Inquiry says the school focused on protecting its reputation and ignored complaints.
